{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''research facility''' of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] produced prototype [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] models in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], discovered it and reported its existence to [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]]. A lone [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]] was sent to [[Attack on TIE prototypes|obliterate]] it.
